gmail_integration_provider_account_id_fo.name: gmail_integration_provider_account_id_format
gmail_integration_provider_account_id_fo.value:
length("provider_account_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
        AND "provider_account_id" = btrim("provider_account_id")
        AND "provider_account_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

gmail_integration_provider_email_format.name: gmail_integration_provider_email_format
gmail_integration_provider_email_format.value:
length("provider_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND "provider_email" = btrim("provider_email")
        AND "provider_email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+$'

gmail_integration_scopes_format.name: gmail_integration_scopes_format
gmail_integration_scopes_format.value:
length("scopes") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048
        AND position('https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly' in "scopes") > 0
        AND position('https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email' in "scopes") > 0

gmail_integration_credentials_status_con.name: gmail_integration_credentials_status_consistency
gmail_integration_credentials_status_con.value:
("status" = 'DISCONNECTED' AND "credentials_ciphertext" IS NULL
          AND "access_token_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("status" <> 'DISCONNECTED' AND "credentials_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
          AND "access_token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

source_message_identity_shape.name: source_message_identity_shape
source_message_identity_shape.value:
(
        ("provider" IS NULL AND "provider_account_id" IS NULL AND "provider_message_id" IS NULL
          AND "provider_timestamp" IS NULL AND "legacy_reference" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("provider" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_account_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "legacy_reference" IS NULL)
      )

source_message_provider_identifiers_none.name: source_message_provider_identifiers_nonempty
source_message_provider_identifiers_none.value:
"provider" IS NULL OR (
        length(btrim("provider_account_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
        AND length(btrim("provider_message_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048
        AND length("provider_account_id") <= 1024
        AND length("provider_message_id") <= 2048
      )
